users_role_organization_consistency.name: users_role_organization_consistency
users_role_organization_consistency.value:
("users"."role" = 'super_admin' AND "users"."organization_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("users"."role" <> 'super_admin' AND "users"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL)

contacts_company_fields_consistency.name: contacts_company_fields_consistency
contacts_company_fields_consistency.value:
"contacts"."kind" = 'person'
        OR ("contacts"."first_name" IS NULL AND "contacts"."last_name" IS NULL AND "contacts"."birth_date" IS NULL
            AND "contacts"."company_id" IS NULL AND "contacts"."company_name" IS NULL AND "contacts"."job_title" IS NULL)

commissions_state_dates_consistency.name: commissions_state_dates_consistency
commissions_state_dates_consistency.value:
(("commissions"."state" = 'prevue' AND "commissions"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "commissions"."settled_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("commissions"."state" = 'confirmee' AND "commissions"."settled_at" IS NULL)
        OR "commissions"."state" = 'reglee')
        AND ("commissions"."confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "commissions"."settled_at" IS NULL OR "commissions"."settled_at" >= "commissions"."confirmed_at")

commissions_basis_fields_consistency.name: commissions_basis_fields_consistency
commissions_basis_fields_consistency.value:
("commissions"."basis" = 'percentage' AND "commissions"."rate" IS NOT NULL AND "commissions"."fixed_amount" IS NULL)
        OR ("commissions"."basis" = 'fixed' AND "commissions"."fixed_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "commissions"."rate" IS NULL)

deal_events_single_actor.name: deal_events_single_actor
deal_events_single_actor.value: NOT ("deal_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_events"."actor_partner_id" IS NOT NULL)

deal_stage_changes_single_actor.name: deal_stage_changes_single_actor
deal_stage_changes_single_actor.value: NOT ("deal_stage_changes"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_stage_changes"."actor_partner_id" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_auto_single_source.name: tasks_auto_single_source
tasks_auto_single_source.value: NOT ("tasks"."source_share_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."source_commission_id" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_auto_source_consistency.name: tasks_auto_source_consistency
tasks_auto_source_consistency.value: ("tasks"."auto_rule" IS NULL) = ("tasks"."source_share_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."source_commission_id" IS NULL)

tasks_recurrence_needs_due.name: tasks_recurrence_needs_due
tasks_recurrence_needs_due.value: "tasks"."recur_unit" IS NULL OR "tasks"."due_at" IS NOT NULL

activities_has_subject.name: activities_has_subject
activities_has_subject.value: "activities"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL OR "activities"."deal_id" IS NOT NULL
